<p id="p3" data-pid="3" class="themeScrp">(<a class=" jsBibleLink" data-bible="nwtsty" data-requested-bible="" data-targetverses="60002009" href="/id/perpustakaan/alkitab/alkitab-pelajaran/buku-buku/1-petrus/2/#v60002009" target="_blank">1 Petrus 2:9</a>)</p>
<div class="bodyTxt">
<ol class="source">
<li>
<p id="p4" data-pid="4" class="p4 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">1. </span>Orang-orang terurap,</p>
<p id="p5" data-pid="5" class="p5 sz">Ciptaan baru Allah,</p>
<p id="p6" data-pid="6" class="p6 sp">Dijadikan anak-Nya,</p>
<p id="p7" data-pid="7" class="p7 sz">Dikasihi Dia.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p8" data-pid="8" class="p8 se">(REFREIN)</p>
<p id="p9" data-pid="9" class="p9 sp">Mereka anak-Mu, </p>
<p id="p10" data-pid="10" class="p10 sz">Milik yang istimewa,</p>
<p id="p11" data-pid="11" class="p11 sp">Yang sayang pada-Mu,</p>
<p id="p12" data-pid="12" class="p12 sz">Senang memuliakan-Mu, Bapak.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p13" data-pid="13" class="p13 sl"><span id="page52" class="pageNum refID" aria-hidden="true" data-no="52" data-before-text="52"> </span><span class="txtSrcBullet">2. </span>Allah panggil mereka</p>

<p id="p15" data-pid="15" class="p15 sp">’Tuk pancarkan terang-Nya,</p>
<p id="p16" data-pid="16" class="p16 sz">Jadi bangsa suci.</p>

<p id="p18" data-pid="18" class="p18 sp">Mereka anak-Mu, </p>
<p id="p19" data-pid="19" class="p19 sz">Milik yang istimewa,</p>
<p id="p20" data-pid="20" class="p20 sp">Yang sayang pada-Mu,</p>
<p id="p21" data-pid="21" class="p21 sz">Senang memuliakan-Mu, Bapak.</p>
</div>
</li>
<li>
<p id="p22" data-pid="22" class="p22 sl"><span class="txtSrcBullet">3. </span>Mereka dengan rajin</p>
<p id="p23" data-pid="23" class="p23 sz">Kumpulkan domba lain,</p>
<p id="p24" data-pid="24" class="p24 sp">Pada Kristus setia,</p>
<p id="p25" data-pid="25" class="p25 sz">Menaati dia.</p>
<div class="chorus">
<p id="p26" data-pid="26" class="p26 se">(REFREIN)</p>
<p id="p27" data-pid="27" class="p27 sp">Mereka anak-Mu, </p>
<p id="p28" data-pid="28" class="p28 sz">Milik yang istimewa,</p>

</div>
</li>
</ol>
